blocks.text: New app icon — updated to the hexagon logo.
Multi-band Compressor — OUTPUT knob now correctly applied after all three bands.
Glitch — FIRE RATE and grid cells now sync to the audio engine in real time.
Distortion — drive pad now renders a grid and crosshair overlay.
Update checker — status panel in Settings now displays checking, downloading, and error states correctly.
macOS — Acid Lab is now available as a .dmg for Intel Macs (Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon).
